name: dubmog
description: Dub a video or audio file into another language with your DubMog account.

interface.longDescription:
DubMog dubs a video or audio file into another language, inside ChatGPT, with your own DubMog account: translate a lecture, a course, a podcast, an interview, a product demo or a clip you have the rights to, and listen to it in your language with a natural voice.

Give ChatGPT the file (an upload, or a direct link to a media file in your cloud storage) and the language you want. DubMog transcribes the speech, translates it line by line with the same rules its apps use, voices it in the new language and places every line where the speaker starts, synced to the speech. The original voice is silenced under each dubbed line; the music and sound between the lines stay. You get the dubbed file back, with the transcript and the translation.

Languages: English (US, UK, Australian), Spanish (Spain, Latin America), French (France, Canada), German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Mandarin (Simplified, Traditional) and Hindi.

What works in ChatGPT is what works in the DubMog apps, with the same account: two voices, Standard and Cinematic. The Cinematic voice uses the dubbing time your DubMog account holds, one second per voiced second, and stops cleanly when it runs out — nothing is lost, and the dub continues from the same line once the account holds time again. Your account's dubbing time is managed in the DubMog apps and on get.dubmog.com, not in ChatGPT.

You can also translate a transcript or subtitle text line by line, see how much dubbing time your account has left, list the dubs you made in ChatGPT, and delete any of them (the files are removed from DubMog's storage at once; otherwise they expire after seven days).

Live, real-time dubbing of speech, calls and videos is in the DubMog apps and the Chrome and Edge extension. Links to YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo and other streaming or social sites are not supported here: DubMog dubs media files you own or have the rights to.
defaultPrompt: Dub this French lecture into English so I can listen to it
Translate this transcript into French, line by line

positive.expected_behavior: Returns a download link to the Spanish-dubbed mp4 with the transcript and the translation; mentions no prices or plans.

positive.description: Direct link + source language + cinematic voice
positive.prompt: Dub https://get.dubmog.com/chatgpt/review/sample-lecture.mp4 (it is in English) into German with the cinematic voice
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a German dub and states how much dubbing time the dub used and how much is left on the account.

positive.prompt:
Translate this transcript into French, one line per line:
Welcome to this short lecture about rivers.
A river begins as a small stream, high in the hills.
Thank you for listening.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the same three lines in French, in order, nothing merged or added.

positive.prompt: How much dubbing time do I have left on DubMog?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the plan tier and the remaining dubbing time; no offer to buy more.

positive.prompt: List my DubMog dubs, then delete the oldest one
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent dubs, asks for confirmation before deleting (destructive tool), then confirms the deletion; the old download link stops working.

negative.prompt: Dub this YouTube video into Spanish: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ
Translate this email into French: Hi Anna, thanks for the meeting yesterday...
Buy me more DubMog dubbing time

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Dubbing time and plans are managed only in the DubMog apps and on get.dubmog.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: dub a video or audio file into 15 languages with your DubMog account, translate transcripts, check dubbing time, list and delete dubs.
